messages:
maria_ml: Morning! I'm Maria (new ML infra). Struggling to view Grafana dashboards after clicking the Okta app. Datadog looks fine. Anyone seen this before?

devex_maya: Welcome Maria :tada: Quick check: are you seeing the Grafana org selection prompt or a permission error?

maria_ml: Permission error: 'You do not have permission to view this dashboard'. Okta shows 'Redwood Grafana' app as connected.

infra_lee: We sometimes miss the group mapping. Can you paste one dashboard link? Also confirm your email (corp).

maria_ml: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/efgh5678/models-inference-latency
Email: maria.lopez@redwood.ai

help-bot: TIP: Grafana viewer access = group `redwood-grafana-viewers`. If Okta app is connected but no group, submit #help with the dashboard URL.

sre_jordan: Filed a quick sync to add maria_lopez to viewers. Also adding Sentry read for projects: inference, model-monitoring.

maria_ml: Thanks! Also FYI the Grafana link had a query param that stripped orgId — it showed a blank page when I pasted into another window.

devex_maya: Good catch — copy full URL from browser. When Lee confirms, you should get access in <30m. After that run through the Observability onboarding checklist in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ONBOARD/Observability.

infra_lee: Confirmed added to `redwood-grafana-viewers` and Sentry invites sent. Log out/in if you don't see it immediately.

maria_ml: I can see the dashboards now and Sentry access works. Appreciate the quick help :heart:
